item.title: v6.28899.2
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.328.

For administrators of SSH hosts: SSH helper version e7672c0ae0f00f48e6a334d0647132f6490a5f6c. SSH host launcher contracts: 1 (sessions), 2 (plugin commands).

General

  • Changed Claude Code's managed allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers back to how they were before 6.6395.0. In Chat and Cowork they don't apply to servers under Settings > Developer, so stopped servers run again. To apply them there, set desktopMcpServersListScope to all where you set them.
  • Changed PostToolUse hooks in Claude Code's managed settings to no longer run for tool calls refused before the tool started, so logs that these hooks write lose those entries.
  • Changed text typed while a page is loading to be cleared if you switch organization in another window. A first message that is waiting to send isn't sent, and a notice says so.
  • Improved recovery from a failed Claude Code download: the app tries again on its own within minutes instead of waiting for a restart.
  • Fixed a likely cause of brief freezes on Windows PCs with no Claude Code managed settings in the registry. If you add them, the app's own checks, such as allowed SSH hosts, can take about 6 hours to see them, not 30 minutes, unless the app is fully quit and reopened.
  • Fixed a message in Chat or Cowork looking sent and then disappearing when you pressed Stop before Claude had read it. It now shows as Stopped, with Retry.
  • Fixed Claude on Linux turning off hardware acceleration and showing a crash notice after a logout or shutdown.
  • Fixed Claude staying closed after an update on Windows Server. Starting with the next update, it opens again by itself. This fix doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Fixed file previews and live artifacts: right-click opened no menu, pages stayed small when the app was zoomed in, Find showed no results after clicking in, and the keyboard could get stuck. F6 now returns to the app.
  • Fixed MCP servers added to claude_desktop_config.json while the app is running being removed again, and a brief network error interrupting replies and uploads in progress.
  • Fixed plugins turned on in Claude Code's managed settings on the device never installing when they have their own git repository. Sessions now fetch them in the background, unless nonessential traffic is off (disableNonessentialTelemetry in third-party deployments). This adds git and npm traffic.
  • Fixed Quick Entry messages sometimes being lost without notice when sent while the main window was loading.
  • Fixed remote MCP servers staying disconnected after a long outage such as a VPN drop. Most https servers are now retried in the background for about a day. In third-party deployments, this doesn't cover servers in managedMcpServers: the app tries those again when they're next used.
  • Fixed sessions failing to start on Windows when the organization sets hundreds of tool rules, allows marketplaces with very many plugins, or a session has very many saved approvals.
  • Fixed the window freezing when opening, resuming, or hovering a Code session or local Cowork task that contains very large connector results.

Code

  • (breaking) Changed SSH sessions to ignore a project's plugin settings on your computer. Project- and local-scope plugins no longer reach the same path on the host (install them there or at user scope), and user-scope plugins the project turned off now do, unless managed or user settings stop them.
  • Changed allowedWorkspaceFolders in local sessions so that Plan mode works. Claude can now read plans in Claude Code's plans folder, and write them there in Plan mode, though that folder is outside the listed folders.
  • Changed Auto mode to ignore allow rules that run any package, such as Bash(pnpm dlx *), so its safety check decides those commands. This covers pnpm dlx, npm exec, yarn dlx, bun x and pnpx. A rule that names the package, such as Bash(pnpm dlx cowsay:*), keeps working.
  • Changed files that Claude creates over SSH or WSL to follow a stricter login-shell umask. Other accounts may be unable to read them.
  • Changed local file previews. Claude no longer runs code in a PDF, picture or video, and only looks at PDFs. Sites that an HTML or SVG file embeds or calls show as signed out. If Claude opened the file, it loads web content and follows links only after you choose Load web content or open it yourself.
  • Changed sessions to start without environment variables that can change how Claude Code loads. The environment editor names any you saved and says where to move them.
  • Changed SSH sessions saved in Auto, Accept edits or Bypass permissions to stay in Plan or Manual at launch if they moved there while the app was closed.
  • Changed SSH setup to not connect to a Linux, macOS, or Git Bash host whose login wrapper, ForceCommand, or startup file drops or changes the first line that setup's first command prints. A banner printed before that line doesn't cause this. ssh.log on your computer shows what came instead.
  • Changed the built-in browser so Claude can't use claude.ai or artifact pages in Code sessions at organizations with zero data retention for Claude Code. This doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Fixed a new session sometimes running an MCP server that had just been removed from ~/.claude.json, when the app could not read that file. This fix doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Fixed edits on Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7 and newer models failing with "File has not been read yet" after a long conversation is compacted, for an unchanged file outside the project that Claude had already read in full.
  • Fixed shell commands in zsh stopping with a "not found" error at a word that starts with =, such as [ a == b ].
  • Fixed SSH sessions failing to start with "The proxy setting isn't a valid URL" on a host whose https_proxy or HTTPS_PROXY is a host and port with no http:// in front.
  • Fixed the Terminal, Changes, Files and Rewind keyboard shortcuts doing nothing in a session opened in its own window.
  • Fixed WSL sessions starting a wsl.exe process for every folder when listing files, which could slow down or freeze the computer.

Cowork

  • Changed Record a skill to stop recording when the screen locks, the computer sleeps or, on Mac, you switch users. The recording waits for you to choose Done or Discard, and is discarded after an hour.
  • Improved how soon a new task is saved, which makes it far less likely to go missing from the task list if the app closes unexpectedly just after the task was started.
  • Improved steps that Auto mode stops: the collapsed step now says "Blocked", the line above a group of steps counts them, and a blocked file or agent step opens to show why.
  • Fixed "Not enough disk space" appearing on macOS and Linux when the workspace update would have fit.
  • Fixed a case where the workspace failed to start, and the app could restart to download and set it up again, after the computer went to sleep while the workspace was starting.
  • Fixed Claude not finding your plugins and skills in scheduled tasks, and in other Cowork tasks that aren't open on screen, in third-party deployments.
  • Fixed Claude reinstalling its workspace and restarting on Windows when the computer didn't have enough memory.
  • Fixed Cowork and Chat failing at every start where disableSideloadFlags reaches Claude Code but the app can't read it first, as with a policy helper. A card now says so, and Try again continues without the desktop's plugins.
  • Fixed Cowork sometimes failing to start on slower Windows and Linux computers.
  • Fixed deleting a single Cowork task sometimes leaving part of its conversation on the computer.
  • Fixed Global instructions opening empty and overwriting the saved instructions when the file could not be read.
  • Fixed tasks on Windows sometimes failing to start when a task folder was briefly locked or unreadable.
  • Fixed the workspace download failing when the computer went to sleep several times before it finished, and starting over when an app update was installed before it finished.

3P

  • (breaking) Changed Auto mode, Code's default, on Gateway connections: your gateway's provider now runs the safety check. If no result comes back, Code waits five minutes for someone to pick Continue, then ends the turn. Check your gateway, or set inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks to false.
  • Changed Auto mode where a Claude apps gateway serves your settings: sessions use the provider's check. Don't add inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks to gateway.yaml, or the gateway won't start. To avoid the check, set autoModeEnabled to false in each policy, which turns Auto mode off.
  • Changed Auto mode requests on Gateway connections to carry session details such as rules, folder paths, a user name and Git state. If the gateway refuses them with a 401 or 404, the turn fails. false in inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks avoids this until Claude Code drops the built-in check.
  • (breaking) Changed userPluginMarketplacesEnabled: when it's off, plugins kept in skills folders usually no longer load, so their hooks and servers stop. /plugin-authoring is off too. Plain skills still load. Only a local session with such a folder and no launcher shows a notice.
  • Changed SSH sessions left running through this update where userPluginMarketplacesEnabled is off: Claude's questions and prompts go unanswered. When someone opens or messages a session, Claude Code restarts, and a running tool call and background shells are lost. Let work finish before updating.
  • Added autoModeRules, which tells Auto mode in Cowork and Code what your organization trusts and what to block or allow. A model applies these rules, so a block isn't guaranteed. To keep the built-in rules, start each list with $defaults. A malformed value turns Auto mode off until you fix it.
  • Added sshHostSandboxUnavailable (beta). Set it to refuse to stop new SSH sessions on all Windows hosts, and on other hosts where Claude Code's sandbox can't start. The key's help lists the cases it doesn't cover.
  • Added an "Allow for all tasks" choice for tools of a plugin's remote MCP server, in Chat and in Cowork's Manually approve mode. It also covers unattended scheduled Cowork tasks, unless mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays is set. To turn it off, set mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled to false.
  • Added Auto mode as a choice for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 with Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry or a Claude apps gateway. People can pick it in Code, and in Cowork where autoModeEnabled is true. It isn't the default on these models. Setting autoModeEnabled to false ends Auto mode on every model.
  • Changed chatSessionRetentionDays and coworkSessionRetentionDays: soon after updating, the app can permanently delete idle chats, with their artifacts, and Cowork tasks that older versions kept. To keep them, before updating, set all three periods to 3650 days in the configuration that sets them.
  • Changed chatSessionRetentionDays and coworkSessionRetentionDays: when both are set, the app can also delete folders left by chats and Cowork tasks it has no record of, for example if the app stopped in a task's first seconds. A folder is deleted once it is unchanged for the longer of the two.
  • Changed chatSessionRetentionDays, coworkSessionRetentionDays and Free up space: an idle chat or Cowork task no longer lasts one more period each time a person turns a connector or tool on or off. Renaming, pinning or moving it to a project no longer counts as activity. Sending a message does.
  • Changed egressProxyPacUrl and system PAC files in local Code sessions, except on the Claude API. Where the script answers DIRECT for a GitHub host, tools can now skip your proxy, and fail if your firewall blocks GitHub. To keep a host on the proxy, have the script return your proxy for it.
  • Changed mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled: when it's false, Claude now asks again before it reads or acts on a saved private-network site in the built-in browser.
  • Changed otlpResourceAttributes: a service.name set there now replaces claude-code-desktop in what Code sessions send to your collector. Dashboards that filter on the old name stop matching. Cowork and Chat still send cowork.
  • Changed Auto mode in Cowork on macOS and Linux. Where autoModeEnabled is true, its safety check, not an approval card, now decides whether Claude can save a skill, request a folder or change a scheduled task. A folder outside allowedWorkspaceFolders is still refused. Windows keeps the card.
  • Changed Plan mode, which Claude can enter by itself, on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 with Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry or a Claude apps gateway. Auto mode's safety check now decides on shell commands instead of asking. To keep prompts, set autoModeEnabled to false. That ends Auto mode on every model.
  • Changed scheduled Cowork tasks to stop at 10,000 turns instead of 100, so long tasks can finish. A task stuck in a loop can use far more tokens on your provider. inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow with inferenceTokenWindowHours stops it, but cached tokens don't count toward that limit.
  • Changed the built-in browser (builtinBrowserEnabled) where Auto mode is available: each click and drag now goes to Auto mode's safety check, in every permission mode. Your provider runs each check, which adds usage. A click is refused if the check gives no verdict.
  • Changed the built-in browser in Cowork (builtinBrowserEnabled) to hide recognized password, one-time code, card and Social Security number fields from Claude. Screenshots show grey boxes, and page text leaves them out. It can miss fields, and screenshots still show numbers that a page prints.
  • Changed the Up arrow in an empty message box to move focus to the last message in Chat and Cowork. Cmd+Up (Ctrl+Up on Windows and Linux, after Insert+3 with JAWS) now brings back the last prompt.
  • Changed what happens when a person's MCP server from claude_desktop_config.json or an extension has the same or a similar name as your organization's. Your organization's server is now used in Chat, Cowork and Code. The person's stays off, and the app says why. Renaming it there brings it back.
  • Improved recovery from "Prompt is too long" in Cowork, Chat and Code when one reply's tool results overfill the context window. Claude now compacts without the largest results and goes on, or the next message works. Scheduled tasks, very large PDFs and some gateways can still end the session.
  • Improved the error people see when they click Connect on a managed connector's page and your server answers with HTTP 403. If the response body is a JSON-RPC error, the error can now show its message, so you can tell them whom to ask. Any other body shows the usual error.
  • Fixed allow not removing the prompt for MCP tools of plugins from allowedPluginMarketplaces, in Chat and in Cowork's Manually approve mode. Set it in orgPluginSettings or a policy-only entry under the server's exact name. An allow already set applies when you update, so check yours first.
  • Fixed responses from a gateway being cut off after about 5 minutes of silence, however high inferenceStreamIdleTimeoutSec was set. On the Code tab, values above 900 seconds add nothing.

item.title: v6.6395.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.326.

For administrators of SSH hosts: SSH helper version 13047a5194346a68538f5525406bf5f861013d73. SSH host launcher contracts: 1 (sessions), 2 (plugin commands).

General

  • (breaking) Changed Claude Desktop on macOS to ignore a user-level configuration profile where a machine (computer-level) profile exists. Before updating, move settings you still need, including retention periods, to the machine profile. Afterward, the diagnostic report lists the settings lost.
  • Changed approval shortcuts to need a second press when keyboard focus is outside the approval card. The first press moves focus to the button. Press the same key again after a moment to confirm.
  • Changed local MCP servers added under Settings > Developer: Claude Code's managed allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers now apply to them in Chat and Cowork too, not only in Code. A refused server stops after the update, and a notice says so.
  • Changed sessions to wait for the Claude Code download after an app update, instead of starting a much older copy left on the computer. In third-party deployments only Code sessions wait, and an older copy still starts if the download doesn't finish in time.
  • Removed the Transcript text size setting. Transcripts now read at one size. Use zoom to make them larger.
  • Fixed dictation sometimes dropping your last words after you stop it.
  • Fixed keys and pastes being entered twice on macOS, in Claude and sometimes in other apps, while another app was intercepting Claude's keyboard input.
  • Fixed MCP servers added in Claude Desktop, and desktop extensions, staying available in open Cowork and Code sessions after an admin turned them off in the admin console. This fix doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Fixed menu shortcuts doing nothing or showing the wrong keys on German, French, Swiss and other non-US keyboard layouts on macOS and Windows, and letter shortcuts such as Ctrl+K doing nothing on Russian, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai keyboards on Windows and Linux.
  • Fixed React and Mermaid file previews loading forever when the network blocks the preview host. After 20 seconds they now name the host and offer View source and Try again.
  • Fixed the app ignoring Increase contrast on macOS and contrast themes on Windows. A change to the setting takes effect the next time the app starts.
  • Fixed update problems: Check for Updates saying nothing when a download failed, some updates that Windows refused not being retried after the computer restarts, a failed newer download putting off the automatic restart, and one cause of Macs coming back on the same version after an update restart.
  • Fixed windows on macOS 27 sometimes staying frozen or blank after switching between windows that cover each other.

Code

  • Added iPhone Duo support to the iOS Simulator pane: test your app on an iPhone Duo simulator and fold it closed, half open, or open. Requires Xcode 27.1 or later (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed admin restrictions on the built-in browser and saved SSH passwords to be remembered from an earlier launch, so they hold while your organization's settings load or can't be reached. This doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Changed Auto mode to ignore some wildcard shell allow rules, such as ones that name no program or that start with $HOME, in managed settings too. The safety check then decides those commands.
  • Changed sandboxed shell commands: after each one, a symlink that appeared in a repository's .git folder during the session is renamed to .<name>.claude-sandbox-quarantine-<id>, or deleted if the disk is full or the name too long. To keep one, rename it back once no session uses the repository.
  • Changed worktree sessions to stop updating your local base branch, and your checkout's files with it, in the background. Use git pull to update that branch.
  • Fixed "Archive all" and "Delete all" ending an SSH task that was still running after the app quit or updated, with no warning.
  • Fixed a case where the iPhone Duo simulator ignored taps shortly after the phone was closed.
  • Fixed a half-written reply being lost when the app quit while Claude was responding.
  • Fixed an automatic archive deleting new, uncommitted files written in a session after its pull request merged.
  • Fixed Auto mode being offered again at launch when your organization turned it off and its settings couldn't be loaded. This fix doesn't apply to third-party deployments.
  • Fixed messages queued before quitting occasionally going missing after the app restarts.
  • Fixed resumed sessions losing earlier conversation history when Claude Code ran low on memory, and losing recent turns after a crash when the previous turn ended with an empty reply.
  • Fixed Settings > Storage offering to remove a worktree with a detached HEAD, which could lose commits that aren't on any branch.
  • Fixed SSH sessions losing their conversation, and the message you had just sent, when Claude Code was started on a host whose home folder was not back yet.
  • Fixed the app deleting the files a session with no folder left behind after it moved to a folder.
  • Fixed the last words of a dictated message being left out when it was sent with the microphone still on or right after stopping it.

Cowork

  • Added a prompt on macOS to keep a folder connected to a cloud session when the folder is renamed or moved, so you don't have to connect it again.
  • Changed the card where Claude asks to delete a scheduled task: it now warns that sessions the task started may be removed too, and Delete needs a click instead of Enter.
  • Changed website permission cards to show Deny first and the main Allow button last, so the first button that Tab reaches is now Deny.
  • Removed Ghostscript, so Claude can no longer convert or render .eps and .ps files, or run gs, ps2pdf or pdf2ps (for example to shrink a PDF).
  • Fixed computer use on macOS often refusing clicks and typing when it could not read an app's window, and refusing Command-A in the file name box, forward delete, shift-click and the expand arrow while a Save dialog is open. Input is still not sent to an app that is not responding.
  • Fixed Cowork asking for a new sign-in when a firewall, proxy, or VPN blocked the sign-in request.
  • Fixed scheduled tasks' attached files: the automatic move to the cloud skipped some tasks, cloud tasks couldn't read a file after it was attached to another chat, and removing an unreachable trusted folder took files from other tasks. On Windows, a task with a web download can still stay local.
  • Fixed shell commands stopping after about 3 minutes when Claude asked for a longer time limit, up to 10 minutes.
  • Fixed some tasks showing "This page ran into a problem" each time you opened them, when their saved history held an incomplete entry.
  • Fixed tasks on Windows showing "Something went wrong" instead of starting when many plugins are enabled.
  • Fixed the app sometimes quitting and relaunching itself on Windows and Linux when Cowork was slow to start.
  • Fixed the built-in browser carrying on with its remaining batched actions after you stop a cloud task.
  • Fixed the workspace failing to start: on Windows after its virtual machine had stopped unexpectedly, and with "Claude Code setup failed" when the computer blocked the app from rewriting an unused file in its data folder.

3P

  • Added a side panel in Cowork and Chat that keeps a connector's interactive app open next to the conversation.
  • Added an automatic restart for tasks on Linux SSH hosts. If the app closes in a crash, an update or similar and Claude Code ends mid-task, the app restarts it when it next reaches the host. It continues in the saved permission mode, with nobody at the computer. A normal quit prevents this.
  • Changed allowedWorkspaceFolders in local Code sessions: Claude can now use the Read tool on a long tool result that its own session saved, though that file lies outside the listed folders.
  • Changed builtinToolPolicy and disabledBuiltinTools to use the tool name SetGoal in place of ProposeGoal. Entries that say ProposeGoal are still accepted.
  • Changed remoteFileDownloads (beta): when unset, it now allows all but blocked file types from SSH hosts and WSL in Code. Device policy for this app, a configuration server, Admin Console or managed Claude Code settings keep it limited. A script-installed file doesn't, so set limited in it.
  • Changed an environment list under autoMode in Claude Code's managed-settings.json to replace the built-in entries, as it does in a terminal, so Auto mode may judge some actions differently. To keep those entries, add "$defaults" to the list.
  • Changed Code-tab preview pages to follow coworkEgressAllowedHosts while builtinBrowserEnabled is off, its default. With a list other than *, even an empty one, content from unlisted hosts stops loading and a notice says so. Loopback addresses always load. An unset list changes nothing.
  • Changed first-time sign-in where Claude Code's managed settings, such as forceLoginMethod, restrict it. Someone with no third-party setup yet can't use a Claude API key, and can't use Claude Console sign-in if those settings require another method. Setups in use and other providers keep working.
  • Changed SSH sessions to skip an mcp_tool hook that calls a managedMcpServers server on the person's computer. The action then gets only the usual permission check. To keep the hook, set the tool's exact name to allow in the server's toolPolicy. Cowork and Chat then stop asking for that tool.
  • Changed the .mobileconfig export in Setup to a machine (computer-level) profile. On a Mac with a machine profile, Claude now ignores a user-level profile. A connection set only at user level stops working, and Claude usually opens the claude.ai sign-in page. Move it to the machine profile first.
  • Changed the token limit set with inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow, and the figures in Settings > Usage, to also count Auto mode's built-in safety check and requests that were stopped. People reach the limit sooner, most of all in Auto mode.
  • Removed the 100 MB limits on project files, attached files and output files in an export (claudeAiImport.exportEnabled). An export can now hold up to 20 GB of files, the most an import accepts. A file or sub-folder that can't be read no longer leaves out all of a project's files.
  • Fixed "Merge into existing" leaving an imported project's memory behind. The memory now comes into the project that you keep. Projects already merged on an earlier version don't get that memory back.
  • Fixed autoModeEnabled turned off from a configuration server or Admin Console having no effect on a running app until a relaunch. Running sessions now leave Auto mode. The app still asks for a restart.
  • Fixed coworkSessionRetentionDays and chatSessionRetentionDays deleting some Cowork tasks and chats up to one retention period late on Amazon Bedrock with IAM Identity Center and Vertex AI with Google sign-in. The app can delete overdue ones soon after the update. Free up space now offers them.
  • Fixed cp being refused when copying a single file out of a read-only folder, such as a plugin's own folder or one that allowedWorkspaceFolders marks as read-only.
  • Fixed a web filter's block page signing people out of AWS IAM Identity Center on Bedrock. When such a page stops a new sign-in, the app now names the AWS hosts to allow.
  • Fixed remote connectors asking to reconnect when a network or proxy error kept their background sign-in renewal from finding the sign-in server. The app now keeps the sign-in and tries again.
  • Fixed sessions with many images on Vertex AI stopping at the 30 MB request limit. Claude now compacts the conversation and goes on.
  • Fixed SSH sessions on Linux and Mac hosts refusing file work under allowedWorkspaceFolders, or in a worktree after a reconnect, with the app closed or the computer asleep. The host now uses the folders the session started with, so a tighter list reaches a running session only when the app is back.
  • Fixed Web search showing as "Blocked by your admin" under Connectors where your organization replaces it with its own search connector. A web tool listed in disabledBuiltinTools now has no row there, so Connectors doesn't show that it is off.

item.title: v5.11492.5
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.325.

For administrators of SSH hosts: SSH helper version 87375cc7c944eb9d45c8d9267edc70a4b4827961.

General

  • No user-facing changes.

Code

  • Changed sandboxed shell commands on macOS and Linux: most ask first in Manual and Accept edits, and Auto mode checks many of them. A routine can stop at a prompt. To undo this, add "autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": true to the sandbox block of ~/.claude/settings.json, creating it if needed.
  • Changed sandboxed shell commands so that git worktree add, move and remove fail, as does a commit in a worktree the session was not started in or given.
  • Changed some shell allow rules that name a variable, such as Bash(NODE_ENV*), to stop matching, so those commands ask for approval.
  • Changed workflows in local sessions to pause at your Claude plan's usage limit and continue after it resets, if the reset is within a day and Auto-continue when limits reset is on.
  • Fixed a session staying busy after another of your sessions sent it the same message twice or many messages at once.

Cowork

  • No user-facing changes.

3P

  • Changed certificate checks: under a company CA that limits DNS names, a certificate with IP addresses but no DNS name is refused if its common name is an IP address or a domain the CA does not allow. Turns to such a gateway fail until its certificate lists an allowed DNS name.
  • Changed most shell commands in Claude Code's sandbox (default on managed macOS and Linux) to ask first (see Code). To undo, add "autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": true to the sandbox block of its managed-settings.json (SSH: on the host). A new file needs top-level "parentSettingsBehavior": "merge".
  • Changed nothing about shell prompts in a deployment that runs every session on a server (not an SSH host) and none on the device: that server runs its own Claude Code, not the app's. Keep autoAllowBashIfSandboxed out of that server's managed settings, or it refuses to start sessions.
  • Fixed sessions failing to start on Windows when the organization's managed settings are very long, for example a long model list or many allowed hosts.
  • Fixed turns failing when a gateway answers with 403 for an expired token from a credential helper, or for a sign-in past its stated expiry. Claude now gets a fresh token and retries.

item.title: v5.11492.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.321.

General

  • Added Developer > Export Configuration Template, which exports ADMX and Profile Manifest policy templates for the settings of standard Claude Desktop, third-party inference, or both.
  • (breaking) Changed the built-in browser and preview panes to send a client certificate only to sites that device management lists in builtinBrowserClientCertificateHosts. A site that requires one stops loading there until it is listed. Behind a proxy that asks for one on every site, use *.
  • Changed builtinToolPolicy: ask rules with arguments, such as Bash(curl *) in Code or Read(~/.ssh/**), now show the approval prompt on devices with their own Claude Code managed settings, unless those settings set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.
  • Changed automatic restarts for updates on macOS to wait while the keychain is locked, for up to 72 hours. A locked keychain doesn't delay restarts timed by autoUpdaterEnforcementHours or installedUpdateEnforcementHours.
  • Fixed a likely cause of brief freezes on Windows when opening a session or answering an approval after its notification had left the screen.
  • Fixed Claude reopening as a blank window on Windows after it was closed while minimized.
  • Fixed Claude Setup on Windows offering people without administrator rights an install that removes their working MSIX install of Claude; it now opens that Claude instead.
  • Fixed Code and Cowork losing a Claude.ai sign-in when a company proxy or gateway answers its background renewal with a JSON error.
  • Fixed edits to an artifact being lost when you left your chats or Cowork tasks within a few seconds of typing.
  • Fixed the app on macOS restarting by itself after ten idle minutes to install an update while the keychain was locked, which left it unable to read its stored secrets until the next restart.
  • Fixed the import from Claude (third-party) leaving out scheduled tasks, projects with no session, and accepted project instructions from a Claude Desktop export that the user confirmed as their own.

Code

  • Changed Auto mode in local Code sessions: a session that Claude started can now start more sessions for its task with no approval, if Auto's check allows it. The limits are 10 per message you type and 5 at once.
  • Changed local, SSH and WSL Code tab sessions, except scheduled runs, to ask before using a connector tool that the organization limits to "Needs approval" in claude.ai, in every permission mode. Outside Auto and plan mode the prompt can offer "Allow for this session". Not in third-party deployments.
  • Changed SSH sessions on the built-in SSH library, including with sshTransport (beta) set to builtin: on Mac and Linux hosts, MCP servers from claude_desktop_config.json now run under Claude Code on the host, as they do over OpenSSH. They follow the host's MCP rules and stop with the session.
  • Changed which cleanupPeriodDays the app follows: one set on the computer in Claude Code's managed settings now counts if server-managed settings set none and the person's own (default 30 days) isn't shorter. Not in third-party deployments.
  • Fixed a rare case on Windows where ending an SSH sign-in could close an unrelated program.
  • Fixed an administrator's env values for tool and workflow variables in Claude Code's managed settings being ignored in local sessions when the computer already set the same variable.
  • Fixed local scheduled tasks and Remote Control sessions with no model of their own ignoring the model in an organization's Claude Code managed settings. Not in third-party deployments.
  • Fixed most automatic SSH connects over the built-in SSH library sending phone sign-in prompts again and again while nobody is at the computer. These connects now try the SSH key alone, and a host that needs more waits until the person is back.
  • Fixed new sessions starting in Manual when settings make Don't ask the default permission mode.
  • Fixed Rewind saying a code restore had failed, and offering another try, while the first restore could still be changing files.
  • Fixed SSH and WSL tasks staying interrupted when Claude Code was lost while an automatic message was waiting, and messages to an SSH task running while the app was closed waiting 30 seconds or longer; in most cases they now reach Claude at once.
  • Fixed SSH sessions getting no worktree, and working in the real checkout, on hosts where Git is only on the login shell's PATH (nix, conda, Homebrew on Linux).
  • Fixed SSH sessions getting stuck, asking for approval again, or running a connector's tool twice or late after the app quit, updated or lost its connection while the tool was being called.
  • Fixed SSH sessions whose key stops being accepted redialling so often that the server blocked the computer's address, and sessions behind a proxy command or jump host that is slow after a wake staying on "Reconnecting" instead of reconnecting by themselves once you are back (Mac, Linux).
  • Fixed the model menu offering models outside an administrator's managed-settings availableModels list when a user or project settings file listed others. Not in third-party deployments that set inferenceModels.
  • Fixed Try again in SSH and WSL sessions sending the words "Try again" instead of your message, after Claude Code stopped before reading it.

Cowork

  • Added Download to the menu of files from tasks that run on your computer, so you can save a copy wherever you choose.
  • Changed connecting a folder by its path to a task that runs on your computer: Claude now refuses a path that goes through a link inside a folder such a task uses, if the link leads outside that folder. Choose the folder where it really is, not a link to it.
  • Changed GitHub access in tasks with restricted network access to clone and fetch only. In these tasks, git push, Git LFS and SSH remotes no longer work. Deployments that use the organization's own model provider see no change.
  • Changed what commands Claude runs can do on registry.npmjs.org, registry.yarnpkg.com and crates.io: downloads and npm audit still work, but publish, login and other requests are refused. Not affected: tasks whose Domain allowlist is "All domains", and third-party deployments.
  • Improved ejecting external drives on macOS: Claude now tries to release a drive shortly after a command on it ends, so that you can eject the drive while Claude is open.
  • Fixed a connected folder that you renamed, moved or deleted coming back as an empty folder the next time Claude ran a shell command.
  • Fixed a Cowork task or third-party chat staying blank, with no reply or notice, after safeguards flagged a message.
  • Fixed a task that kept asking before each web search after the administrator lifted an ask on web search.
  • Fixed attached files missing from new copies of Cowork and Chat sessions from an earlier organization or another Claude profile, and file cards and files from earlier turns not opening in copies. Also fixed new imports from an export file failing at every message behind some inference gateways.
  • Fixed Cowork tasks going missing on Windows 11 and later after Claude switched back to an earlier copy of its data. Third-party deployments are not affected.

3P

  • Added autoModeClassifierModel, which chooses the model for Auto mode's built-in safety check in Code and Cowork. Actions your provider reviews itself don't use it. If unset, Claude Code chooses the model. A device's CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL environment variable no longer counts in Code.
  • Added builtinBrowserClientCertificateHosts: the sites that get a client certificate in the built-in browser and preview panes. Behind a proxy that asks on every site, use *. Only machine-wide device management can set it. On Linux, or as a Windows policy's only key, add it after updating.
  • Added deploymentLogo, which shows your organization's logo beside the organization announcement. Paste a PNG image as a base64 data: URI. Update all devices before you put it in a device profile.
  • Added enforceConsoleSignInOrgList (device profile only): when on with forceLoginOrgUUID set, only listed organizations can use Claude Console sign-in, so add your Console organization's ID first. Off or unset, others still work with a log warning. The block announced earlier now needs this key.
  • Added remoteFileDownloads (beta), which controls which files users can download from an SSH host or WSL in Code sessions. When it is unset, users can download documents, images and small text files. Read its help before you set it in an MDM profile: devices can lose settings or WSL sessions.
  • Added sensitivityLabels to the configuration reference. On the built-in Microsoft 365 entry of managedMcpServers, it blocks OneDrive and SharePoint files and Outlook email that carry the Microsoft Purview labels you list. Update first: versions before 5.1231.0 block only files, or nothing.
  • Added a Minimize button to the Terminal, Browser, and side chat panes in the Code tab. The Browser pane has it only with builtinBrowserEnabled on.
  • Added Mermaid diagrams for mermaid code blocks in replies and Markdown file previews in Chat, Cowork, and the Code tab.
  • Added Web search and Web fetch under Connectors in the + menu and in Customize > Connectors. Each person can set either one to Always ask or Blocked, but can't loosen builtinToolPolicy or disabledBuiltinTools. On Bedrock, only Web fetch is listed.
  • (breaking) Changed the built-in browser and preview panes to send a client certificate only to sites in builtinBrowserClientCertificateHosts. With builtinBrowserEnabled on, a site that requires one stops loading there until you list it. Gateway and connector connections are not affected.
  • Changed allowedWorkspaceFolders on Windows SSH hosts: sessions and Claude's file tools now refuse a junction or folder link in an allowed folder that leads outside the list. To keep using it, add the folder it leads to.
  • Changed autoUpdaterEnforcementHours and installedUpdateEnforcementHours: with no number set, the restart on macOS now waits while the keychain is locked, for up to 72 hours, so that a saved provider API key still opens afterwards. With a number set, a locked keychain doesn't delay it.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport: most Cowork and Chat sessions it copies from this version on now continue at the user's first message, with no "Continue this conversation?" prompt. Code sessions and sessions copied by earlier versions still ask.
  • Changed a connector tool set to blocked through device management to take effect without a restart. At the app's next configuration check (every 10 minutes by default), open sessions refuse it. This covers connectors that the app itself connects to.
  • Changed connectors on a Claude apps gateway: some people need to reconnect theirs once after this update. This can happen on a computer login that several people share, or on one that used another sign-in method before the gateway.
  • Changed connectors that the app itself connects to: in Auto and bypass modes, a tool set to ask now shows the approval prompt whether the policy names the connector by name or by URL. In an unattended scheduled run, the tool does not run unless a person approves it.
  • Changed the Code tab's model menu when inferenceModels is set: an availableModels list in a Claude Code settings file, managed or not, no longer greys out models, unless Claude Code's managed settings name a policy helper.
  • Removed the in-app deprecation warning about coworkTabEnabled, chatTabEnabled and chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled. Versions 4.16336.0 to 5.1231.2 can still show it from November 17, 2026. From 4.16336.0 on, the app stops reading these settings at 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026.
  • Updated the help for orgPluginSettings and managedMcpServers: write a plugin server's name exactly as the plugin declares it, capitals included.
  • Fixed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport dropping Auto mode from scheduled tasks. From this version on, a copied task on Auto or Skip all approvals arrives on Auto. If the task was switched on, it runs in Auto. Cowork tasks need autoModeEnabled set to true. Code tasks need it unset or true.
  • Fixed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport leaving behind sessions imported from a file or folder, and projects and scheduled tasks brought from another computer with "Import as my own". Computers that already ran the copy get those projects and tasks at their next launch, with the tasks turned off.
  • Fixed scheduled tasks copied by claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport: History now lists their earlier runs, and a Cowork task can open its own task folder when its prompt gives the full path. Tasks copied by earlier versions do not change.
  • Fixed sessions stuck on "Authentication failed" after a slow sign-in refresh. Claude now asks you to try again in a moment and keeps your message.
  • Fixed the Setup window showing Unified Claude on for a configuration that leaves only Code on. Until December 17, 2026, saving, exporting or importing such a configuration in Setup writes desktopHome as off.

item.title: v5.1231.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.321.

General

  • Added run status to scheduled tasks that run on your computer, in Cowork and Code. A task's card can now say "Last run failed", "Last run failed, will try again", "Needs input" or "Didn't run", or why a run that is due hasn't started, such as "Waiting for its previous run to finish".
  • Changed Claude on Windows so that it can stop at launch with the message "Claude could not start" when another program keeps using a file that Claude needs. When Windows starts Claude at sign-in, it stops with no message. Close other programs or restart the computer, then open Claude again.
  • Changed Claude on Windows to keep its data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude-Data: new installs start there (Windows 10 21H2 or later and Windows Server 2022, as on Windows 11), and existing data moves there on Windows 10 21H2 or later. The Microsoft Store version and third-party deployments are unchanged.
  • Changed computer use on Windows to need the "Use system shortcuts" permission before it presses the Windows key with Tab, a number key or a symbol key.
  • Changed file opening to refuse Windows file types that install or apply something at a double click (.msix, .appx, their bundles and encrypted forms, .msu, .ppkg, .xbap, .gadget, .sct, themes, styles and troubleshooter packs).
  • Fixed a file sometimes being lost on Windows when two files with the same name were saved to Downloads at the same moment.
  • Fixed an artifact in the side panel reloading when reopened within a few minutes of using Refresh on it, which could lose unsaved edits.
  • Fixed an occasional crash on Linux when typing after the built-in browser was hidden.
  • Fixed Claude being unable to read or act on pages in the built-in browser for some signed-in accounts until they signed out and in again.
  • Fixed Claude Setup refusing to install with "Trusted app installs must be enabled" on Windows 11 24H2 and later where Windows itself allows the install. When Windows blocks apps from outside the Microsoft Store, the message now also gives the address of the Windows deployment guide.
  • Fixed emailed sign-in links doing nothing when clicked again after a failed sign-in attempt.
  • Fixed Run on startup not starting Claude at sign-in on Windows (Microsoft Store and other MSIX installs).
  • Fixed scheduled task notifications saying "Scheduled task completed" when the run went on without a step. They now say "Scheduled task skipped a step" when the step needed your approval and nobody was there to give it, or "A safety check blocked a step" in Auto mode.
  • Fixed the first "Sign in again" after a launch not renewing the Code tab's and Cowork's saved credentials.
  • Fixed the saved sign-in being lost when a proxy answered its renewal with a "200 OK" of its own, and sessions failing to start while still signed in when a proxy or Wi-Fi portal answered a sign-in renewal with a web page.
  • Fixed the window staying blank for a long time after a page stopped responding, on Windows and macOS.

Code

  • Changed MCP servers added in the desktop app, desktop extensions included, to follow the MCP allow list, deny list and plugins-only setting in an administrator's Claude Code managed settings, in Code sessions on this computer. The session's MCP list says which servers are kept out.
  • Changed SSH sessions on Mac and Linux behind several jump hosts: once a jump host has asked you for a password or code in this version, a dropped session no longer redials it over and over. It retries rarely and tells you to sign in.
  • Changed the app on third-party deployments to stop updating your checked-out base branch in the background after it makes a worktree for a session. Use git pull to update that branch.
  • Changed worktree sessions on SSH and WSL hosts: a folder whose .git Git can't use is now refused in most cases, and the card says why. Such a session used to start without a worktree.
  • Fixed an SSH session that could miss a new sign-in made while the app was re-attaching to it, and stop later with an authentication error.
  • Fixed deleting a session leaving files on disk: the oldest of over 1,700 earlier conversations, saved command output and temporary files after Claude moved to another folder mid-session, and on Windows the conversation file after the app had moved its data to a new folder by copying it.
  • Fixed file edits on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, /net mounts) that could change only the first of several matches, replace a whole file, or delete or overwrite a notebook's first cell.
  • Fixed pull request status, checks, and auto-fix failing with "HTTP 401" for GitHub Enterprise Server hosts behind an authenticating proxy that the GitHub CLI can pass.
  • Fixed running sessions staying in Auto mode after a device policy turned it off, and added a notice when Claude Code takes a session out of auto mode on its own, saying if an admin's policy did it, or that the app couldn't check why.
  • Fixed the automatic local cleanup on Windows not removing older sessions' records and unsent messages from folders that an earlier move of the app's data left behind, for organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration.
  • Fixed the Code tab freezing when many sessions are open.

Cowork

  • Changed Cowork so that edits Claude makes to a session's CLAUDE.md no longer update your global instructions. To change them, use Settings.
  • Fixed a comment you were typing on a file being lost when Claude sent an updated version of that file.
  • Fixed a crash when many pending approval requests closed at once.
  • Fixed an earlier Cowork task not opening, with no message, on a computer that can't run Cowork. The task now opens read-only and says why.
  • Fixed Automatically approve not switching on in a Cowork task right after you pick a model that can run Auto. The switch now works at once, without sending a message first.
  • Fixed prompts in imported sessions: "Go back" on the first-message prompt showed your message as sent instead of returning it to the message box, and "Continue" or "Trust and resume" could send an earlier message a second time if the prompt was left unanswered and the session reopened.
  • Fixed the automatic local cleanup on Windows not removing older tasks, uploads and cached project copies from folders that an earlier move of the app's data left behind, for organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration.
  • Fixed your own message losing characters such as underscores and asterisks when copied with its Copy button and pasted back into an empty message box.

3P

  • Added "Allow for 30 days" to the prompt shown before a scheduled Cowork task deletes files in one of its own folders. Later runs can then delete there without asking. mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays sets the number of days, and 0 turns the option off.
  • Added organizationAnnouncement: a message from your organization that each person can close, shown as a card on the start screen or as a dialog. It shows again when you change its id, or its text if it has no id. Update all devices before you put it in a device profile.
  • Added a warning when other Claude Code managed settings on a computer override this app's policy there. The diagnostic report shows it with the fix, local Code sessions show a notice, and your OTLP collector gets an event.
  • Changed autoModeEnabled set to false through device management to take effect without a restart. At the app's next configuration check (every 10 minutes by default), running Cowork tasks and Code sessions, except WSL sessions, leave Auto mode and say so.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport to keep Cowork projects' descriptions and folders, and Cowork sessions' folders. The folders are connected again without asking the person, so Cowork can read and change their files as before the move. Copies made by earlier versions don't get them back.
  • Changed managedMcpServers: a local server can leave out its own command if platformOverrides names only win32, darwin or linux, each with a command. It runs only on those systems. Update all devices first: older versions drop it, and block plugins' MCP tools if that empties the list.
  • Changed Code sessions on Windows under an organization's configuration to ask before starting a project's dev server in the Auto and Bypass permission modes, as on macOS and Linux.
  • Changed Cowork tasks in Auto mode to wait for Auto mode's check before each shell command, usually one more request to your provider. A command that the check blocks, or cannot check, does not run.
  • Changed each model ID in inferenceModels to allow only the version it names, so claude-opus-5 no longer also allows claude-opus-5-5. On the Claude API, a list of only retired Opus 4 or 4.1 models no longer starts sessions. List a current model.
  • Changed scheduled tasks to retry a run that fails on a server error from your provider or gateway, such as 500 or 529, before Claude responds. Retries end six hours after the first failure. One refused token renewal no longer ends a sign-in through your gateway or identity provider.
  • Changed sessions and scheduled tasks saved on a model that inferenceModels doesn't list to run on the default model, which is the first model in the list.
  • Changed Sign in with Google on Vertex AI: hooks, MCP servers on the computer and commands in the Code tab that call Google Cloud now need the person's own Google Cloud credentials on that computer, for example from gcloud auth application-default login.
  • Changed the credential, client-secret, headers and environment helpers set in managed configuration to start in / on macOS and Linux and in System32 on Windows. A helper that reads or writes a file by a relative path must now use its full path.
  • Changed what an unset desktopHome does where only Code is on. Versions 4.4212.0 to 4.23118.1 turn on Unified Claude there from 12:00 PM PT on November 10. This version waits until 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026. To keep only Code, set desktopHome to off wherever your settings come from.
  • Removed the "Open external link" confirmation for most links to other websites, on third-party deployments too. It still shows for some links, such as private IP addresses, names ending in .local or .internal, punycode (xn--) host names, and email or phone links. No setting brings it back.
  • Removed the Chat, Cowork and Advanced file analysis switches from the Setup window, starting 12:00 PM PT on November 10, 2026. The Unified Claude switch, which sets desktopHome, takes their place.
  • Fixed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport dropping project pins, sidebar groups and artifacts' earlier versions, and copying nothing when the computer had no earlier sessions. Computers moved by an earlier version get these once, at their next launch. Scheduled tasks copied then run if they were on.
  • Fixed a saved provider API key on macOS not being read at launch when the first of two keychain prompts was closed and the second was answered, or when a device management tool opened Claude with the root account's home folder.
  • Fixed Auto mode blocking every action it checks in sessions on a Fable or Mythos model when the model list has no Sonnet 5 and no Opus entry tagged with anthropicFamilyTier. The check now uses a listed Opus 4.5 or newer.
  • Fixed connector tools set to ask in toolPolicy not showing an approval prompt in Auto mode on devices with their own Claude Code managed settings. They now ask, so unattended scheduled runs stop at them.
  • Fixed connectors losing their sign-in when the sign-in server was slow to answer a token renewal or did not answer it. The Connectors page could also stay loading in that case.
  • Fixed Cowork tasks and chats showing "Claude Code crashed" when your organization's managed settings for Claude Code, such as a minimum version, stop it from starting. They now show "Claude Code couldn't start" and the reason.
  • Fixed new Code sessions starting on the model and effort of the folder's last session when alwaysStartWithDefaultModel is on. They now start on the default model and effort.
  • Fixed the token limit set with inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow not counting the tokens that subagents and conversation compaction use. People now reach the limit sooner, most of all in tasks that use subagents.

item.title: v4.23118.1
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.321.

General

  • Changed how Claude Code finds the programs it starts itself on Windows, such as git: it no longer finds them through network (UNC) or relative PATH entries, or behind a link to a network share. Where Git is found only that way, sessions use PowerShell instead of Git Bash.
  • Changed the certificate that signs Claude Code on macOS to a newer Developer ID certificate of the same Anthropic team (Team ID Q6L2SF6YDW). Rules that match the Team ID are unaffected; rules that pin the certificate itself need the new certificate added beside the old one.
  • Fixed replies stopping with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply. Claude now keeps what arrived and continues.

Code

  • Changed skills in a subfolder's .claude/skills folder to no longer load during a session when Claude Code's sandbox is on. To use them, start the session in that subfolder.
  • Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders.
  • Fixed the project's skills, commands and agents that a worktree lacks, such as files git does not track, disappearing from the menu after Claude entered that worktree. While there, the main project folder's copies are listed and run.

Cowork

  • Fixed a task or chat showing "Claude Code crashed" at the next message when its saved state file was cut short.

3P

  • Changed fable in inferenceModels to request the newest Fable model, unless your gateway's /v1/models has an ID fable or a model tagged Fable. Requests can fail if that model isn't served. To pick one, keep fable and add an entry with its exact ID and anthropicFamilyTier set to fable.
  • Changed tool calls made by a plugin's own code (a mod), rather than by Claude, to never show an approval card. They now run where only the user's approval or Auto mode would have stopped them, including connector tools with no toolPolicy entry. Such calls to a tool set to ask are refused.
  • Fixed Cowork's Progress panel not ticking steps that a subagent marked done.

item.title: v4.23118.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.317.

General

  • Changed the organization setting that blocks other accounts on a computer: once a member has signed in there, the Claude API key and Console sign-in and the computer's own third-party setup are unavailable too while the block lasts.
  • Fixed a new chat's saved draft being deleted when only spaces or blank lines were typed before the draft had loaded.
  • Fixed connections failing with a certificate error on computers whose company root certificate was renewed with a new key.
  • Fixed Enter or Tab in the "/" menu running a command you had not chosen, or sending your half-typed text, when more commands finished loading.
  • Fixed losing the saved sign-in when a company proxy or firewall answered its renewal with a block page.
  • Fixed permission and question cards and the "Paused" and "Switched to" notices being cut off, with some buttons out of reach or running out of the card, at 400% zoom or in very short or narrow windows, and the "Switched to" notice not closing there.
  • Fixed the third-party history import, the Code tab's queued message and task list, and several saved app files not being read on Windows when the user profile lives in an FSLogix profile container.

Code

  • Added a Minimize button to the Terminal, Browser, and iOS Simulator panes. A minimized pane stays as a small live view in a corner of the chat, or in the session rail when it's shown. You can expand it again or close it, and in a corner you can also move and resize it (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed SSH sessions to hold a message that has waited over a day for its host: it stays above the message box until you press Send now.
  • Improved reconnecting SSH sessions through a slow proxy command or jump host on Mac and Linux: your message or Retry now waits up to 90 seconds, unless the SSH config sets ConnectTimeout.
  • Improved SSH sessions on hosts that ask you to sign in at every connection: they can now ride out longer network gaps without a new sign-in.
  • Fixed SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR in Claude Code's managed settings being overridden in Code sessions when the same variable is set on the computer.
  • Fixed a Windows issue where quitting during a settings save could leave ~/.claude.json empty.
  • Fixed attached files sometimes failing to upload when the network connection changed during the upload.
  • Fixed Claude being unable to read the files of plugins turned on in the managed-settings file when allowed workspace folders are set, for organizations with no server-managed settings.
  • Fixed HTML previews in SSH and WSL sessions showing empty charts and tables that the page's own scripts draw. Organizations that set disableBrowserExternalNavigation in Claude Code's managed-settings.json keep scripts off in these previews.
  • Fixed SSH sessions failing to start: "Couldn't start the remote server" on hosts whose home folder is on a slow network drive, and Claude Code start failures on Windows hosts that are not set to English, where low memory and similar causes are now retried and shown with their own message.
  • Fixed SSH sessions losing background work on the host after your Claude account's sign-in ran out while the app was away.
  • Fixed SSH sessions not reconnecting by themselves after the network drops during a sign-in (with a saved password: one more try while you are at the computer, and one about 30 minutes later if nobody is; Mac and Linux) or after a long outage when the host's firewall limits new connections.
  • Fixed the app reconnecting over and over, signing in each time, to an SSH host whose shell start-up files print text or change HOME, now saying what to fix at the first refusal, and SSH sign-in questions from an earlier jump host getting lost when a later jump host shares connections.

Cowork

  • Fixed a comment on a file seeming to send from a read-only task. It is now saved on the file.
  • Fixed Cowork deletions left unsent on the few Windows PCs where an October update moved the app's data folder only part way.
  • Fixed imported tasks sometimes starting without your organization's allowed domains when the app was slow to start.
  • Fixed imported tasks using Memory after your admin or you turned Memory off.
  • Fixed new cloud tasks requesting a model that isn't available to you.
  • Fixed removing an import from Settings > Import leaving behind a task whose saved record could not be read.
  • Fixed the app closing, reopening and setting up Claude's workspace again when the workspace could not download or set up its copy of Claude Code.

3P

  • Added "Apps gateway admin" to the user menu, where a Claude apps gateway's spend admins set spend limits and pooled budgets, see spend, and export spend by group and the log of spend limit changes. It shows where people use the gateway's own sign-in and bootstrapUrl is on the gateway's address.
  • Added claudeCodeProcessWrapperEnabled: starts Code sessions through the processWrapper launcher in Claude Code's managed settings, on the device or the SSH host. The launcher must supply the inference credential. Not used for sessions that run on Windows, in WSL or in Cowork.
  • Added disableDesktopLocalSessions: turns off Code sessions that run on the device, WSL included, so Code offers only remote environments such as SSH. Set sshHostAllowlist too.
  • Added disableWslSessions (MDM profile only): blocks Code sessions inside WSL. Unset, they stay blocked on managed devices, and only a machine-wide false allows them.
  • Added sshConfigs (beta): SSH connections offered to everyone in Code's environment menu. Every connection is still checked against sshHostAllowlist.
  • Added a "JSON config (redacted)" export to Setup on managed devices, for importing into the Admin Console. The values of API key, token and header settings are masked. Check URLs, arguments and text fields before sharing it.
  • Added a "Your usage limits" card to Settings > Usage that shows your session and weekly usage limits, where you sign in to a gateway in the app and it reports them. Spend limits do not show there.
  • Added a confirmation before you add, upload or turn on a plugin that your organization didn't provide.
  • Added a dismissible in-app notice, where a device profile sets forceLoginOrgUUID, that the saved Claude Console sign-in will stop working after a future update because its organization is not on the list. It shows the organization's ID to add.
  • Added memory to scheduled Cowork tasks that are not in a project: when memory is on, they can read what Cowork remembers but do not save new memories.
  • Added sign-in for a plugin's own connector in Cowork and Chat. One sign-in serves all your tasks, chats and scheduled tasks.
  • (breaking) Removed organizationPluginsUrl. Plugins it installed no longer load, even where the key is still set. Offer any you still need through allowedPluginMarketplaces.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.enabled: Import now also brings projects, memory, scheduled tasks, saved skills, uploaded plugins and some preferences from a Claude Desktop export that the user confirms is their own. Memory and preferences apply at once. Tasks, plugins and skills arrive turned off.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.exportEnabled: an export now also holds attached files, projects and their files, memory, scheduled tasks, saved skills, uploaded plugins, some preferences and local MCP servers. Passwords or API keys in them are included. Sign-ins and the servers' variable values are not.
  • Changed disableNonessentialServices to also stop the Code tab from reading the status of GitLab merge requests and Gerrit changes. GitHub is not affected.
  • Changed Chat and Cowork on macOS and Linux to ignore cross-certificates between old and renewed private root CAs. If a gateway's or proxy's issuing CA names one by serial number, requests can fail with a certificate error. Put both roots and that CA in the certificate store, then restart Claude.
  • Changed Cowork and Chat so the line that shows what Claude is doing reads "Needs your input" while a task waits for you, and "Nothing new from Claude for 2 minutes", counting up, once Claude has sent nothing for two minutes while no tool is running.
  • Changed Cowork and Chat to stay at your sent message while a long reply appears. To follow the reply, scroll to the end or press the round button above the message box.
  • Changed downloaded updates on macOS and Windows to install sooner: Claude restarts by itself after ten minutes with no Claude window in use and no task running. disableAutoUpdates still turns updates off.
  • Changed HTML previews in SSH and WSL sessions to run the page's inline scripts. To keep them off, set disableBrowserExternalNavigation in Claude Code's managed settings (it also limits the Browser pane to localhost). In a new file, add parentSettingsBehavior: "merge" to keep Desktop's policy.
  • Changed local Code sessions on macOS and Linux: where an organization's configuration sets allowedWorkspaceFolders, or leaves coworkEgressAllowedHosts unset or without *, Claude can still read Terminal panel tabs but no longer opens or types in them. Your own use of the panel is unchanged.
  • Changed profiles exported from Setup with Deployment mode set to Third-party only to also set disableDeploymentModeChooser, so that earlier versions hide Claude.ai sign-in too.
  • Fixed /etc/claude-desktop/managed-settings.json on Linux refusing the unredacted JSON config that Setup's Export menu writes. Earlier versions still refuse it.
  • Fixed live artifacts that failed on a connector tool nobody had approved, with nothing to click. The artifact now asks the person to allow the tool.
  • Fixed Settings > Import & export asking for an app update, with no way to sign in or choose a file, on computers with an older Claude Code. Import now downloads the Claude Code it needs.
  • Fixed the built-in GitHub connector's tools failing behind a proxy. They now follow egressProxyPacUrl, egressProxyUrl or the system proxy. For a ghe.com tenant, also allow api.<tenant>.ghe.com.
  • Fixed uploaded plugins working only in the tab they were uploaded from, or missing on MSIX installs below Windows 11 and where the app's data folder is reached through a link. Upload earlier ones again, choosing Replace if asked, to use them in every tab.
  • Fixed what you see at a Claude apps gateway's spend limit or group budget: the Code tab shows the gateway's own message instead of rate-limit errors, notices no longer offer a plan upgrade, and the "Billing issue" banner is hidden while those notices show.

item.title: v4.16336.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.317.

General

  • Changed sessions to ignore cross-certificates between old and renewed private root CAs in the certificate store. If a proxy's or gateway's issuing CA names one by serial number (Authority Key Identifier), requests can fail with UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY. Add that issuing CA to the store.
  • Deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026, after which fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8.
  • Removed claude.ai from the sites the built-in browser can import cookies for from another browser. If you imported claude.ai before, you are signed out of it in the built-in browser at the next launch.
  • Removed the tools that let Claude list and start shortcuts saved in the Claude in Chrome extension.
  • Fixed Claude on Windows staying open with no window after Windows declines an update.
  • Fixed dictated words being lost: Quick Entry dictation on Mac could close without adding what you said, and words still arriving in one message box could be discarded when a message was sent from another box on the same page.
  • Fixed files chosen in the message box being added after the signed-in account changed.
  • Fixed scheduled tasks failing silently: Claude now notifies you when a run couldn't use a connector that needs reconnecting, and when a run can't start.
  • Fixed the app coming back hidden or behind other apps, or the Dock icon on macOS showing no window, when the app was opened again (from its Dock icon, a link, a file, or a tray or menu bar item) while it was restarting to install an update or restarting on its own.
  • Fixed the Windows installer closing Claude and then failing on computers where an organization's policy blocks apps from outside the Microsoft Store, and leaving Claude closed when an installation fails after it has closed the running app.

Code

  • Changed worktree sessions: Claude Desktop no longer runs git's post-checkout hook when it makes a worktree; Claude Code's own worktrees run none either. pre-commit and other hooks still run for commits there. To copy ignored files like .env into new worktrees, list them in .worktreeinclude.
  • Removed the Windows fallback that read Claude Code's managed-settings.json from C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode. Keep the file in C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode, the only folder that Claude Code itself reads.
  • Fixed "Trust new key" failing for SSH hosts on Windows virtual desktops that use FSLogix or similar profile containers.
  • Fixed desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays (in Claude Code's settings) not deleting old transcripts of sessions still in the sidebar. Claude Code's cleanup now deletes them at the age its settings give, and they can't be restored.
  • Fixed a missing warning in SSH sessions when a sandbox that an organization's managed settings turn on can't start on the remote machine.
  • Fixed messages to SSH sessions being lost or stuck with no notice when the connection dropped or Claude Code couldn't start on the host, after the host was rebuilt, or after signing in on the New session page when the first try couldn't connect; they now send, retry, or return to the message box.
  • Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some sessions.
  • Fixed SSH reconnects on Windows setting off a jump host's phone push at every retry with nobody at the computer.
  • Fixed SSH sessions left running overnight stopping with a sign-in error, after Remote Control was denied for the account or after an unrelated crash whose message mentioned "401" or "unauthorized".
  • Fixed the previous account's sessions showing in the list after an account change that keeps the page open.

Cowork

  • Changed HTML and SVG file previews: alert, confirm and print dialogs are removed, including from buttons you click in the page; a page can start a download only shortly after you click in it; and a hung preview no longer stays on screen under the next file's name or keeps running after it closes.
  • Changed Reset App Data to also delete the signed-in account's Cowork tasks from Anthropic servers before it resets, where its confirmation dialog says so. Help > Troubleshooting > Delete Cowork VM Sessions and Restart is now named Delete Cowork Data and Restart.
  • Fixed a case where resetting memory could clear another signed-in account's local Cowork memories if the account changed during the reset.
  • Fixed buttons such as Deny being cut off or out of view on the web fetch, scheduled task, computer use and workflow permission cards in a small or zoomed window.
  • Fixed files added while creating a project from an existing folder emptying or replacing a file already in that folder.
  • Fixed some links in Claude's replies to files on a Windows computer not opening.
  • Fixed the app reinstalling the Cowork workspace (and, on a stop, quitting and relaunching) when the workspace was stopped or Claude was quit while it was still starting, for example by signing out or choosing Help > Troubleshooting > Delete Cowork Data and Restart.
  • Fixed the notice shown when a network blocks, interrupts, or alters the download of Claude's workspace, which advised a restart or a reinstall and could not be closed. It now offers Retry, says what to ask an IT administrator to allow, and can be closed where tasks go on without the workspace.
  • Fixed workspace notices such as "Additional setup needed" covering a permission request or the message box in a short or zoomed-in window, which hid the request and could make Deny and Allow once unclickable.

3P

  • Added deploymentMode (not read from a bootstrap server): the app runs only on your third-party setup (3p), only signed in to Claude.ai (1p), or as each person chooses (any). Older versions read only disableDeploymentModeChooser, which Setup no longer offers: for 3p, set it to true too.
  • Added inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks, a temporary setting, off unless you turn it on, that has the provider behind your gateway check risky Auto mode actions by sending it session details such as folder paths and a user name.
  • Added platformOverrides to sessionStatusLine, to run a different status line program on Windows, macOS or Linux. An older version rejects the whole setting when this is present and shows no status line, so add it only after all devices are updated.
  • Added a warning to the app's log and diagnostic report when a Claude Console sign-in's organization is missing from a device profile's forceLoginOrgUUID list. A coming release will allow only listed organizations, so add your Console organization's ID to the list now.
  • Added the Monitor tool to Code sessions where Bash is available: each new batch of a watched command's output starts a turn, with nobody typing. Turn it off with Monitor in disabledBuiltinTools.
  • (breaking) Changed an unset desktopHome to read as standard at launches after 12:00 PM PT on November 10, 2026, even where chatSessionRetentionDays is set. New conversations that are Cowork tasks are deleted by coworkSessionRetentionDays, not chatSessionRetentionDays, so set both.
  • (breaking) Changed SSH on Windows to reach hosts new to the device (every host, on PCs that keep no app data) through Microsoft OpenSSH 9.4 or newer, not the built-in library. To stay on the library, set sshTransport to builtin everywhere you manage settings. Mac and Linux then use it too.
  • Changed inferenceModelPricingEnabled: when on, each session's estimated cost now shows above the message box in Cowork, Chat and Code, not only on the Usage page. Where sessionStatusLine is set, its program's line shows there instead.
  • Changed a PreToolUse or PermissionRequest hook whose command is only a quoted path or string, with no shell, args or "onFailure": "continue", to block calls on PCs without Git for Windows. Install Git and reopen Claude, or for an .exe unquote it, add "args": [], "onFailure": "block".
  • Changed a setting left past its deprecation date, such as organizationPluginsUrl, to be ignored, not an error. A device profile holding only such settings no longer locks local settings or sets aside the Admin Console's configuration, whose retention periods then delete idle sessions for good.
  • Changed Code sessions on Linux hosts where AppArmor stops the sandbox, such as Ubuntu 24.04 over SSH: shell commands that failed now run unsandboxed, so coworkEgressAllowedHosts and allowedWorkspaceFolders don't limit them. An AppArmor profile for bubblewrap on the host restores it.
  • Changed how autoMode lists in Claude Code's managed-settings.json apply in local Code sessions and Cowork tasks: an allow list without "$defaults" replaces the built-in exceptions, and a soft_deny or environment list without it adds to the built-in rules. Auto mode may ask or block more.
  • Changed recurring scheduled tasks to retry for up to about three and a half hours, up from about one, when the inference provider can't be reached. Claude notifies you of the first failure and the final outcome, and when tasks are waiting for you to sign in again.
  • Changed SSH from Windows over OpenSSH: each connection signs in at least twice and keeps the sign-ins open, so a per-user login limit must leave room and a one-time code or push is asked at each. The sign-in dialog offers Remember password, and the SSH sessions docs page says how to turn it off.
  • Changed the Code tab on devices whose only configuration is a local file, even one copied by a script: with coworkEgressAllowedHosts unset and blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories off, shell commands can reach the network. An empty list still blocks them where Claude Code's sandbox runs.
  • Changed which program opens SSH connections from Windows over OpenSSH, now the default: ssh.exe, not Claude.exe. Where a firewall or endpoint rule allows SSH by program, allow ssh.exe too. If it starts but can't reach the network, the connection fails and the built-in library does not step in.
  • Deprecated coworkTabEnabled, chatTabEnabled and chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled: desktopHome replaces them. Remove them before 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026. Users see a warning from November 17 while one is still set.
  • Deprecated sessionRetentionHold (Suspend session deletion): ignored from 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026, when retention periods permanently delete idle sessions it kept. To keep them, first set all three periods to 3650 days where they are set. Once devices have the new periods, remove the key.
  • Removed the Chat and Cowork switch from a project's page under Unified Claude. A message sent there now starts a Cowork task, or a chat on a computer that can't run Cowork.
  • Removed the Send to Anthropic button from the diagnostic report. To share a report, export it to a file from Help > Troubleshooting > Generate Diagnostic Report.
  • Updated the app to the new Claude look: new colors, icons and type. In Cowork and Chat, Claude's steps and progress notes now sit behind one status row, which opens with a click.
  • Fixed a "Get set up for agent mode" download prompt appearing in chats and tasks.
